devices.name: NXP i.MX RT1060
devices.notes: NO on-chip flash: the boot image is stored in external QSPI NOR accessed via FlexSPI (MIMXRT1060-EVK = 64 Mb / 8 MB QSPI; typical only, not enforced without a board profile). 1 MB on-chip RAM: 512 KB OCRAM shared with ITCM/DTCM via flexRAM + 512 KB dedicated OCRAM; 128 KB ROM. 600 MHz Cortex-M7. eLCDIF 24-bit parallel LCD controller.
sources: IMXRT1060CEC Rev 2 - i.MX RT1060 Crossover Processors Data Sheet, NXP
IMXRT1060RM Rev 3 - i.MX RT1060 Reference Manual, NXP
NXP MIMXRT1060-EVK product page (64 Mb QSPI flash) (https://www.nxp.com/design/development-boards/i-mx-evaluation-and-development-boards/i-mx-rt1060-evaluation-kit:MIMXRT1060-EVK)
